items.name: layer8labs8/EYRA
items.title: layer8labs8/EYRA
items.description: Eye + Ear + Action for AI agents on Windows. Single-binary Rust MCP server: sees any app as compact text (UI Automation + OCR) - Chrome, Edge, File Explorer, Office, Electron apps, games - hears system audio and mic, and controls mouse and keyboard. Works with Gemini, Claude, Cursor and any MCP host.
